rounds.text: The valuation of Yash Management & Satelite Ltd is fundamentally disconnected from its earnings capacity, as evidenced by a P/E ratio of 127.17x, which is more than double the sector benchmark of 52.12x [E5]. This extreme multiple is particularly concerning given that earnings growth is currently decelerating [E62]. While the company has historically shown sales growth, the most recent data indicates a contraction with trailing twelve-month sales growth at -8% [E16]. Furthermore, the company fails to provide any direct return to shareholders, as the dividend yield is 0.00% [E3]. The firm’s efficiency is also lackluster, with an ROE of 1.35% falling short of the sector benchmark of 2% [E8]. Conceded: [E1], [E6], [E7], [E13], [E14], [E15], [E49], [E58], [E59], [E61], [E68].
